subject: Unexplained hourly burst on June 15 — request for reconciliation
messages:
From: Zoe Chen <zoe@claritech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Team <claritech@claritech.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden usage spike on 2026-06-15 — need breakdown

Hi Marissa,

We noticed a sharp hourly spike in our invoice for June 15 (see attached small sample). The line item shows ~1.8M embedding tokens between 03:00 and 04:00 PDT which is inconsistent with our traffic patterns — we only run a nightly sync that should be under 50k tokens/hour. Can you help: 1) provide a per-request/export sample for that hour, 2) confirm whether those tokens were billed to our production API key or an older staging key, and 3) advise if this is eligible for a provisional credit while you investigate?

I've attached a CSV with the timestamps we see on our side. We are pausing payment on this invoice pending explanation.

Thanks,
Zoe Chen
Head of Engineering Operations
ClariTech

Attachment: claritech_usage_sample_20260615.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Zoe Chen <zoe@claritech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden usage spike on 2026-06-15 — need breakdown

Hi Zoe — thanks for the heads up and for sending the sample. Sorry to hear you flagged the invoice. We'll prioritize this.

Quick plan:
- Ben (billing ops) will pull a per-request export and the token attribution for the 03:00-04:00 PDT window.
- Kimberly (SRE) will check ingestion/job logs for duplicate replay or backfill jobs.
- I'll coordinate a provisional credit if we confirm duplicate billing and share findings by EOD tomorrow.

Can you confirm whether you rotated any API keys or triggered any bulk export/imports from S3 in the early morning on June 15? That info will help narrow scope.

I'll keep you posted.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Billing
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Zoe Chen <zoe@claritech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden usage spike on 2026-06-15 — need breakdown

Hi all — preliminary export attached. Key findings:
- 03:04:12 - 03:15:47 PDT shows a cluster of ~1.6M embedding tokens attributed to API key sk-prod-claritech-01.
- We also see a second set of requests during 03:07:00 - 03:08:30 with identical payload hashes (suggesting a duplicated client retry or a replay job).
- Billing attribution looks like it charged to your production key (sk-prod-claritech-01) rather than any staging keys.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Kimberly to confirm whether a server-side replay/backfill executed around 03:07 that could have replayed the same batch.
2) If duplicate calls are confirmed, we'll prepare a provisional credit covering the duplicated token count and hold final adjustment until you confirm.

I've attached: ingest_job_log_2026-06-15.txt (server-side log sample), and a small CSV extract of offending requests.

Attachment: ingest_job_log_2026-06-15.txt (TXT, 45KB)
Attachment: claritech_usage_sample_20260615.csv (extracted rows)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Zoe Chen <zoe@claritech.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden usage spike on 2026-06-15 — need breakdown

Hi Zoe, Ben — short update and remediation plan.

Root cause (summary):
- Our cluster logs show a scheduled "bulk-index-replay" job was retriggered at 03:05 PDT due to a transient S3 timeout in the orchestration layer. The orchestration retried the same batch twice within a 2-minute window; the KV cache key for the client-side request identifiers did not reflect the initial run because the replay used a different ingestion client id, so requests were treated as new.
- As a result ~1.55M tokens were reprocessed and billed. We consider this a server-side duplication.

What we're offering:
- Provisional credit: full credit for the duplicated tokens (we estimate 1.55M tokens) while we finalize the audit.
- Permanent fix: patch to the replay controller to preserve dedup keys across orchestration retries (deploying next week).
- Preventative: adding a short-lived idempotency token to the ingestion client libraries and an audit alert that fires on high-hourly-per-customer spikes.

I've attached a provisional credit estimate for DEAL-4832. Once you confirm you accept the provisional credit, we'll apply it to your account and reissue the corrected invoice.

Apologies for the disruption. We'll also share the final forensic export (per-request) once the audit completes — aim EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
SRE Lead, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: provisional_credit_estimate_4832.pdf (PDF, 6KB)
